package.description: Open-source AI API gateway with a Windows desktop management interface.

en-US.description: Open-source AI API gateway with a Windows desktop management interface.
en-US.longDescription:
GPROXY Desktop runs an AI API gateway on your Windows computer and provides an integrated setup wizard and management window. Launch it with gproxy-desktop.

Connect your own providers and manage credentials, model routing, load balancing, failover, access keys, quotas and usage. Supported routes provide OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible API formats. Provider accounts, model access and service charges are separate from this application.
en-US.name: GPROXY Desktop
